note: A government-organised training workshop on disability-inclusive disaster governance; it states no accessibility law, programme or delivery.

facts.fact: The civil-society submission says accessibility (CRPD article 9) and reasonable accommodation are not taken up in Comoros's disability law no. 14-037/AU of 2014, which also lacks provisions on freedom of expression and access to information.

note: Persons with disabilities are mentioned as a group to listen to; no measure is stated.
